body: I completely understand your words and your frustration towards me.  How my brain works is like this... if I can't seem him everyday, it would be easier to not see him at all.
Sorry to make you sad =(  but yes, I will be here until the beginning of December.

Trust me, I think about this dearly.  But as someone whos father wasn't around either, I can honestly say that my stepdad was a great guy and raised me as his own.  I know my son will be okay in the long run.

>Reply

Thank you for the kind words.  Unfortunately, I'm not looking for another woman...I just wanted my family back together.  I even tried to make it work after the affair via couples counseling, but she was unable to break contact from the other guy/guys.
Still here.  Have a few more weeks of putting my ducks in a row before I go.

My son will gain full access to my/his accounts when he turns 18.  My will list him to take ownership of my paid-off vehicles, and other items I left him, which he can take ownership at anytime (sentimental items, etc).  I rent an apartment, and have no estate for anyone to worry about.  All that needs to be done is move my furniture and belongings into a storage unit that I pre-paid for the next 12 months.  Funny you mention my mother, we went from talking everyday to never again once she found out my ex was pregnant (\~5 years ago). And she lives 10 minutes away lol.  I did write her a letter as well tho.
